name: RO App
description: RO App (formerly RemOnline) repair-shop and service CRM, Public API v2: orders with statuses and comments, clients, inquiries (leads), products and warehouses, invoices, finance accounts with their transactions, tasks and employees. API key.
instructions:
## RO App
This connector works with the **RO App Public API v2** (`https://api.roapp.io/v2`). RO App, formerly **RemOnline**, is a CRM for repair shops, service centres and field service: orders, clients, inquiries (leads), products and warehouses, invoices, finance accounts and tasks.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. In RO App open **Settings, API** (https://web.roapp.io/settings/api).
2. Copy the API key into `RO_APP_API_KEY`. It is tied to your user profile and can be regenerated on the same page.

The key is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. There is no token exchange in API v2. A wrong key answers 403 with the message Invalid token.

**Where to start**: `ro_app_get_company` checks the key. `ro_app_list_orders` lists repair orders; filter by status ids from `ro_app_list_order_statuses`. `ro_app_get_order` and `ro_app_list_order_items` show one order with its parts and services.

**Orders**: `ro_app_list_orders`, `ro_app_get_order`, `ro_app_list_order_items`, `ro_app_create_order`, `ro_app_update_order`, `ro_app_update_order_status`, `ro_app_add_order_comment`, with the reference lists `ro_app_list_order_statuses` and `ro_app_list_order_types`. A new order needs a location (`ro_app_list_locations`), an order type and a client.

**Clients**: a client is a person or an organization. People: `ro_app_list_people`, `ro_app_get_person`, `ro_app_create_person`. Organizations: `ro_app_list_organizations`, `ro_app_get_organization`, `ro_app_create_organization`.

**Leads**: RO App calls them inquiries. `ro_app_list_inquiries`, `ro_app_get_inquiry`, `ro_app_create_inquiry`, `ro_app_update_inquiry_status`, with `ro_app_list_inquiry_statuses` and `ro_app_list_inquiry_types`.

**Inventory**: `ro_app_list_products` and `ro_app_get_product` read the product catalogue, `ro_app_list_warehouses` the warehouses. API v2 documents no call for the stock quantity per warehouse, so stock levels are not available here.

**Invoices and payments (read only)**: `ro_app_list_invoices`, `ro_app_get_invoice`, `ro_app_list_invoice_items`; `ro_app_list_finance_accounts` and `ro_app_list_account_transactions` show cash boxes, bank accounts and the payments booked on them. The connector creates no payments, transfers or refunds.

**Tasks and staff**: `ro_app_list_tasks`, `ro_app_get_task`, `ro_app_create_task`; `ro_app_list_employees` gives the employee ids used for managers and assignees.

**Paging and filters**: lists return up to 50 rows per page with `count` (the total); ask for the next page with `page`. Most filters take lists of ids. Date filters take one or two ISO 8601 date-times: one is the start, two are a range.

**Limits**: 3 requests per second; more answers 429. Nothing is deleted by this connector.

RO_APP_API_KEY.label: API key
RO_APP_API_KEY.help: RO App, Settings, API: copy the API key. It belongs to your user profile and can be regenerated there.
RO_APP_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key only (letters and digits), without Bearer in front.

verifyHints.400: RO App refused the request. The answer names the field: an id that does not exist, a missing required field or a date that is not ISO 8601.
verifyHints.401: RO App refused the API key. Copy it again from Settings, API in RO App, or regenerate it there.
verifyHints.403: RO App refused the API key: it answers 403 with Invalid token for a wrong or regenerated key. Copy the key again from Settings, API. If the key is right, the user behind it has no permission for this section, or the plan does not include the API.
verifyHints.404: RO App found nothing with that id. Orders, clients, inquiries, invoices and tasks each have their own ids; a document number is not an id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: RO App allows 3 requests per second. Wait a second and try again.

prerequisites: A RO App (formerly RemOnline) account on a plan with API access, and the API key from Settings, API. About 2 minutes.

tools.name: ro_app_get_company
tools.description: Read the information RO App holds about the company account behind the API key. Use it to check that the key works. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations (branches, workshops) of the company: id, name, address and whether archived. The id is the branch_id of orders, inquiries and warehouses. Read-only.

is_archived.description: true: archived locations, false: active ones.

legal_entity_id.description: Only locations of this legal entity.

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of the company: id, name, email, phone, position and group. The id is what managers, assignees and task authors refer to. Read-only.

groups.description: Only employees of these employee group ids.

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_list_orders
tools.description: List repair and service orders: id, document number, status, type, location, client, asset, manager and assignee, problem description, prices and the created, modified, scheduled, due and closed dates. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

statuses.description: Only orders in these status ids (ro_app_list_order_statuses).

types.description: Only orders of these order type ids (ro_app_list_order_types).

branch_ids.description: Only orders of these location ids.

numbers.description: Only orders with these document numbers.

managers.description: Only orders of these manager (employee) ids.

client_ids.description: Only orders of these client (person or organization) ids.

client_names.description: Only orders of clients with these names.

client_phones.description: Only orders of clients with these phone numbers.

asset_uid.description: Only orders for assets with these serial numbers (VIN, IMEI).

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

modified_at.description: Modified: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

closed_at.description: Closed: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

scheduled_for.description: Scheduled from: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

due_date.description: Due: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_order
tools.description: Read one order with all its details: status, type, client and payer, asset, manager and assignee, problem description, notes, conclusion, prices, dates and custom fields. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_order_items
tools.description: List the products and services on an order: each item with its name, quantity, price, cost, discount, tax and warranty. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_create_order
tools.description: Create a repair or service order for a client at a location. Fetch the ids first: ro_app_list_locations (branch_id), ro_app_list_order_types (order_type_id) and ro_app_list_people or ro_app_list_organizations (client_id). Returns the new order with its id.

client_id.description: Client id: a person or an organization.

assignee_id.description: Employee id of the assigned technician.

payer_id.description: Payer (person or organization) id, when someone else pays.

due_date.description: Due date of the order. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00Z.

resume.description: Conclusion and recommendations for the client.

estimated_price.description: Estimated price or price range, as text.

urgent.description: true marks the order as urgent.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON text, e.g. {"f123": "value"}, where the key is f followed by the id of the custom field.

status_id.description: Initial status id. Default: the first status of the order type.

tools.name: ro_app_update_order
tools.description: Update an order: client, asset, manager, assignee, schedule, due date, problem description, notes or custom fields. Only the fields given change. The status is changed with ro_app_update_order_status.

client_id.description: Client id: a person or an organization.

assignee_id.description: Employee id of the assigned technician.

payer_id.description: Payer (person or organization) id, when someone else pays.

due_date.description: Due date of the order. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00Z.

resume.description: Conclusion and recommendations for the client.

estimated_price.description: Estimated price or price range, as text.

urgent.description: true marks the order as urgent.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON text, e.g. {"f123": "value"}, where the key is f followed by the id of the custom field.

tools.name: ro_app_update_order_status
tools.description: Move an order to another status, with an optional comment. Depending on the status rules of the account this can notify the client or close the order.

tools.name: ro_app_add_order_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to the event feed of an order. A private comment is visible to employees only.

is_private.description: true keeps the comment private to employees.

tools.name: ro_app_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List every status an order can have: id, name, colour and group (new, in progress, ready, closed and others). Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_order_types
tools.description: List the order types of the account (for example repair, sale, maintenance) with their ids. An order needs one. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_people
tools.description: List clients that are people: id, first and last name, email, phones, address, tags, manager, discount and whether a supplier. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

phones.description: Only people with these phone numbers.

emails.description: Only people with these email addresses.

managers.description: Only people of these manager (employee) ids.

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

modified_at.description: Modified: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_person
tools.description: Read one person: names, birthday, email, phones, addresses, tags, manager, discount code, tax number and custom fields. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_create_person
tools.description: Create a client that is a person, with a first name and optionally last name, email, phones, address and tags. Returns the person with its id.

phones.description: Phone numbers, e.g. [{"title": "Mobile", "phone": "+380501234567", "notify": true, "has_viber": false, "has_whatsapp": true}]. All five fields are required per number.

title.description: Name of the number, e.g. Mobile.

notify.description: true allows SMS to this number.

has_viber.description: true allows Viber messages to this number.

has_whatsapp.description: true allows WhatsApp messages to this number.

billing_address.description: Billing address, e.g. {"country": "DE", "city": "Berlin", "address_line_1": "Hauptstr. 1", "postal_code": "10115"}. country (ISO code) and address_line_1 are required.

supplier.description: true marks the contact as a supplier.

manager_id.description: Employee id of the responsible manager.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON text, e.g. {"f123": "value"}, where the key is f followed by the id of the custom field.

tools.name: ro_app_list_organizations
tools.description: List clients that are organizations (companies): id, name, email, phones, address, tags, manager and whether a supplier. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

phones.description: Only organizations with these phone numbers.

emails.description: Only organizations with these email addresses.

managers.description: Only organizations of these manager (employee) ids.

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

modified_at.description: Modified: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_organization
tools.description: Read one organization: name, email, phones, addresses, tags, manager, tax and registration numbers and custom fields. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_create_organization
tools.description: Create a client that is an organization (company), with a name and optionally email, phones, address, tax numbers and tags. Returns the organization with its id.

phones.description: Phone numbers, e.g. [{"title": "Mobile", "phone": "+380501234567", "notify": true, "has_viber": false, "has_whatsapp": true}]. All five fields are required per number.

title.description: Name of the number, e.g. Mobile.

notify.description: true allows SMS to this number.

has_viber.description: true allows Viber messages to this number.

has_whatsapp.description: true allows WhatsApp messages to this number.

billing_address.description: Billing address, e.g. {"country": "DE", "city": "Berlin", "address_line_1": "Hauptstr. 1", "postal_code": "10115"}. country (ISO code) and address_line_1 are required.

supplier.description: true marks the contact as a supplier.

manager_id.description: Employee id of the responsible manager.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON text, e.g. {"f123": "value"}, where the key is f followed by the id of the custom field.

tools.name: ro_app_list_inquiries
tools.description: List inquiries (leads): id, document number, status, type, location, contact name and phone, client, manager, comment, due date and created date. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

statuses.description: Only inquiries in these status ids (ro_app_list_inquiry_statuses).

types.description: Only inquiries of these type ids (ro_app_list_inquiry_types).

numbers.description: Only inquiries with these document numbers.

branch_ids.description: Only inquiries of these location ids.

managers.description: Only inquiries of these manager (employee) ids.

clients_ids.description: Only inquiries of these client (person or organization) ids.

client_names.description: Only inquiries of clients with these names.

client_phones.description: Only inquiries with these phone numbers.

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

due_date.description: Due: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_inquiry
tools.description: Read one inquiry (lead): status, type, contact name, phone and email, client, manager, comment, notes, address, due date and custom fields. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_create_inquiry
tools.description: Create an inquiry (lead) of a given type, with the contact name and phone or an existing client, a comment and an optional due date. Returns the inquiry with its id.

client_name.description: Contact name, when there is no client record yet.

due_date.description: Due date of the inquiry. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00Z.

urgent.description: true marks the inquiry as urgent.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON text, e.g. {"f123": "value"}, where the key is f followed by the id of the custom field.

tools.name: ro_app_update_inquiry_status
tools.description: Move an inquiry (lead) to another status, with an optional comment, for example to mark it as won or lost.

tools.name: ro_app_list_inquiry_statuses
tools.description: List every status an inquiry (lead) can have, with id, name and group. Read-only, no parameters.

tools.name: ro_app_list_inquiry_types
tools.description: List the inquiry (lead) types of the account with their ids. An inquiry needs one. Read-only, no parameters.

tools.name: ro_app_list_products
tools.description: List the products (parts and goods) of the catalogue: id, title, SKU, internal code, barcodes, manufacturer part number, category, unit of measure and prices. Filter by name, barcode, SKU, code or category. Read-only.

q.description: Product name or part of it.

category_ids.description: Only products of these category ids.

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_product
tools.description: Read one product of the catalogue: title, SKU, code, barcodes, category, unit of measure, warranty, prices and custom fields. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses: id, name, type and the location they belong to. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices: id, document number, status, client and payer, legal entity, payment method, totals, issue date and due date, and the order they belong to. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

statuses.description: Only invoices in these status ids.

numbers.description: Only invoices with these document numbers.

client_ids.description: Only invoices of these client ids.

payer_ids.description: Only invoices of these payer ids.

managers.description: Only invoices of these manager (employee) ids.

legal_entity_id.description: Only invoices of this legal entity.

payment_method.description: Only invoices with this payment method.

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

issue_date.description: Issued: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

due_date.description: Due: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice: number, status, client and payer, legal entity, payment method, totals with tax and discount, issue and due dates and comments. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_invoice_items
tools.description: List the products and services on an invoice: each item with name, quantity, price, discount and tax. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_list_finance_accounts
tools.description: List the finance accounts (cash boxes and bank accounts) of the company with their ids, titles and payment method types. Read-only; this connector records no payments.

payment_method.description: Only accounts of this payment method type.

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_list_account_transactions
tools.description: List the payments booked on one finance account: direction (income or expense), amount, cash flow category, description, the employee who booked it and the date. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

created_by_id.description: Only transactions booked by this employee.

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks: id, title, description, priority, status, due date, author, assignees and the object they are linked to. Returns the rows of one page with count (the total number of rows); 50 rows per page. Read-only.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds up to 50 rows.

statuses.description: Only tasks in these status ids.

overdue.description: true: only overdue tasks, false: only tasks that are not overdue.

unassigned.description: true: only unassigned tasks, false: only assigned ones.

assignee_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these employee ids.

author_ids.description: Only tasks created by these employee ids.

created_at.description: Created: one or two ISO 8601 date-times. One value is the start; two values are start and end, e.g. ["2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"].

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus sorts descending.

tools.name: ro_app_get_task
tools.description: Read one task: title, description, priority, status, due date, author, assignees, the linked object and its comments. Read-only.

tools.name: ro_app_create_task
tools.description: Create a task with a title and a due date, optionally with a description, priority, assignees and a link to an order, inquiry, invoice, client or another task. Returns the task with its id.

due_date.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-25 or 2026-11-25T15:00:00Z.

assignee_ids.description: Employee ids to assign the task to.

related_object.description: Object the task belongs to, e.g. {"type": "order", "id": 12345}. type is task, inquiry, order, invoice or client.
